events.body:
## Context

`public/trademark-check.html` searches a hardcoded 5-row `mockDB` behind a fake 900 ms "Searching trademark databases..." delay and gives conflict-risk advice from it. `#tmJurisdiction` is never read. `public/index.html` advertises "USPTO & international database search".

## What to do

1. Add a visible "Demo data, not a real trademark search" notice.
2. Apply the jurisdiction filter case-insensitively with an "All" option.
3. Add search links to USPTO/WIPO/EUIPO with the term filled in; soften the index.html claim.
4. Optional: test `similarity()` in `test/trademark-check.test.mjs` using the `pick()` pattern from `test/repo-compare.test.mjs`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Demo notice visible
- [ ] Choosing EU shows only EU rows
- [ ] index.html no longer claims a real database search
- [ ] Tests pass

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-enforcement/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000   # /trademark-check.html?q=owasp
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-enforcement
```

---
Size: **S**. Comment `/assign` to claim this issue; claims with no activity are released after 7 days. Clone from https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT.git and open your pull request there.
